name: Juggernaut
fantasy: The wrecking ball. Gets angrier, crashes through, slams you into the wall.

card.loop: Trading hits fills Rage; Enraged, your Smash hits harder and Rampage winds up twice as fast.
card.dash: Tap: a shoulder shove. Hold: charge an arrow and carry someone into a wall.
card.passive: Rage fills as you deal and take hits; at 100 you're Enraged for 5s.
card.rmb: A knock cone; hold to leap into an Earthshatter slam; in the air, a Meteor Drop.
card.e: Iron Hide: 3s of 30% less damage and no knockback, then a shove.
card.r: Avalanche: 5s unstoppable and faster, stomping everyone around you.

weapons.greatsword: A huge slow 3-hit combo; hold to slam.
weapons.minigun: Spin up, then a hose of rounds.

passive.name: Rage
passive.desc: +8 per hit, +10 per 10% of your health lost, +20 on a wall slam; cools after 3s out of a fight. At 100 you're Enraged for 5s: your next Smash is empowered (+50% knock; Earthshatter +1m and stuns everyone it lifts) and Rampage winds up twice as fast.

dash.name: Rampage
dash.desc: Tap: an unstoppable shoulder charge, 3m, shoves 10 (stun 1.2 into a wall). Hold: wind up to 0.7s while an arrow grows 3 to 7m for everyone to see, then charge it and carry the first hunter to a wall.

variants.tap: The weapon's knock cone: an Overhead Smash (3m, 18, push 6), or the Shotgun's Breach.
variants.hold: Earthshatter: leap up to 7m, a 3m crater that lifts, spikes the airborne (+60%, stun 1.0).
variants.air: Meteor Drop: slam straight down, a 2.5m burst (16, lift, spike stun 0.6).
variants.during_e: During Iron Hide the tap pulls foes within 4m in first.
variants.full: Enraged: +50% knock, Earthshatter +1m and stuns everyone it lifts.

e.name: Iron Hide
e.desc: 3s of 30% less damage and no knockback, with a cleanse on cast. When it ends a 2.5m burst shrugs everyone off (push 10).

r.name: Avalanche
r.desc: A 0.6s unstoppable roar (the fuse), then 5s unstoppable (no stun, root or knockback; slows half strength) and 30% faster, stomping every 0.5s (6, push 6). The first wall slam on each foe stuns 1.0. Rampage charges refill.

rank3.ult: 6s, and the first stomp is a 3m burst

rank2.ult: Rank 2 (level 9): cooldown 115s -> 97.8s, +30% duration, +15% damage; 6s, and the first stomp is a 3m burst.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 9s -> 7.2s, damage +30%; Earthshatter's spike stun +0.2s.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 16s -> 12.8s, damage +30%; the end burst pushes 14.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 12s -> 8.4s; the hold windup is 0.7 -> 0.55s.

tells.full: red eyes and weapon, a roar within 25m
